query: CoreWeave revenue year over year growth latest quarter
normalized: coreweave growth over quarter revenue year

output.content:
CoreWeave’s latest reported quarter is Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026): revenue was **$2.575 billion**, versus **$1.212 billion** in Q2 2025. [[1]] 
That represents **112% year-over-year revenue growth**—more than doubling revenue from the prior-year quarter. [[2]]

sources.title: CoreWeave - CoreWeave Reports Strong Second Quarter 2026 Results
